# sauth_silence (Resource)

The silence records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) app id
- `ends_at` (String) Window end
- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `starts_at` (String) Window start

### Optional

- `monitor_id` (String) monitor id, omitted or the nil uuid to cover every monitor of the app
- `reason` (String) Why deliveries are held
